text:
Sven: Observed perf regression in canary A after merge of PR #9873 (kernel selector changes). P99 latency up ~28% across ~4k synth requests. Pausing staged rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused for release/redwood-runtime@v2.14.2 — reason: latency SLO breach detected (p99 > 200ms).

Maria: Oof. Is this kernel-choice or batching heuristic? Any KV cache stats?

Kevin: KV miss rate spiked ~3x in the canary group per telemetry. Also median batch size dropped (3 -> 1.8). Selector seems to prefer the "generic" kernel that's slower for small batches.

AJ: CI perf job 9873-perf failed on worker-3: `./ci/perf --bench=latency --seq=1024`. Logs show tail growth after commit. Quick snippet: ```[2024-06-12T15:02:11Z] p50=12ms p95=140ms p99=210ms -> [post-merge] p99=270ms```

Sven: Starting bisect across commits touched by PR #9873. CC @Maria @Kevin. Can someone run perf-bisect.sh on canary nodes?

Maria: Running now on canary-1. ETA ~12m. If bisect points to kernel selection policy, we can try revert-or-guard.

ci-bot: perf-bisect job started: https://ci.redwood/integrations/perf-bisect/4589

Maria: Bisect result landed on commit 4f3b7a2 (kernel-selector: prefer_generic for len<=256). Correlates with ~95% of observed regressions. This was introduced in PR #9873.

Kevin: Confirmed repro locally with synthetic tail tests. Switching kernel hint back to previous heuristic restores p99 to ~190ms. Minimal repro command: `./bench --model gpt-small --sequence 512 --batch-dist low` — baseline p99 ~185ms, post-change p99 ~265ms.

AJ: Recommend temporary rollback of that commit from canary and add a runtime guard: do not select generic kernel for quantized models when median batch < 2. Also add CI perf check that runs a low-batch distribution job.

Sven: Agreed. Can someone open emergency PR for revert + unit test? Also propose tweak to autopause rule: require p99 increase >15% over baseline for 5 consecutive 5m windows before allowing staged rollout to continue (reduce noise).

Kevin: Opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/10021 — includes revert + feature-flag to gate the selector change. Added a quick telemetry flag `selector.v2.enabled=false` by default.

oncall: Rolling back canary to v2.14.1 on canary-A. Will watch metrics for 10m.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete on canary-A. New p99 observed ~188ms — back within SLO. :white_check_mark:

Maria: I'll add a CI perf gate: synthetic job that forces low-batch traffic and asserts p99 <= baseline * 1.12. Drafting test and a small harness to simulate KV miss behavior.

Sven: Good work, team. Follow-ups: 1) add unit tests around kernel selector batch-size branches; 2) expose batch-size histogram to canary dashboard (per-route); 3) schedule a short RFC to consider model/quantization-aware kernel profiles (will reduce flapping).

AJ: I'll open the infra tickets and add the guard to rollout config.

Kevin: Leaving a note in the release PR to avoid landing kernel selector heuristics without a low-batch perf check.

Sven: Closing thread once PR #10021 merges and canary stable for 1h. Thanks :thumbsup:
